name: TuSimple Lane Detection Benchmark
description: TuSimple Lane Detection is a benchmark for highway lane detection in autonomous driving perception. It consists of 6,408 one-second video clips (1280x720 resolution, 20 consecutive frames per clip) recorded under diverse weather, illumination, and traffic conditions on US highways, with polyline ground truth annotated on the final frame of each sequence.
